The term vitagene describes the network of genes involved in maintaining cellular homeostasis, protecting against stress, and promoting longevity [1]. Polyphenols are shown to improve inhibit oxidative stress, metabolic dysfunction, and inflammation associated with onset and progression of nervous system disorders. Interestingly , dysregulation of Nrf2 pathway can exacerbate selective susceptibility under neuroin-flammatory conditions due to the high vulnerability of brain cells to oxidative stress. These findings have opened up new perspectives in medicine and pharmacology, as molecules inducing this defense mechanism appear to be possible candidates for novel cytoprotective strategies.
